notes: ALL price_mnt values are INTEGER Mongolian tugrik, NET of NOAT (VAT). MNT has no circulating subunit. Never store money as REAL. VAT is applied at invoice time from billing_config.vat_rate_bp, effective-dated, so the platform can operate pre-VAT-registration (rate_bp=0) and flip to 1000 without any catalog change.

vat.display_rule: Show net as the headline price with the label 'НӨАТ ороогүй', and the gross in a secondary line: '149,000₮ + НӨАТ = 163,900₮'. When billing_config.vat_rate_bp = 0, suppress the VAT line entirely and render only the net.

refunds.cooling_off_scope: first paid invoice of the partner's first paid term only; full refund by bank transfer plus an ebarimt credit note

addons.forward_compat_note: This SKU is the pay-per-lead model living inside the subscription model. A v2 pure pay-per-lead product is the same consumable ledger with units=1 and no base plan requirement.

bundle_contents.unit_note: 2 months equivalent, delivered as an 8-week run

addons.hard_rule: Learner-side promotional push cap is 2 per learner per calendar month across ALL partners and ALL surfaces. Sold inventory is capped to respect it and unsold demand is queued to the next month, never overridden.

coupons.stackable_exception_note: Referral credits post to partner_credit_ledger rather than modifying the subscription price, so they coexist with a price coupon without violating the no-stack rule.
coupons.vesting: credit posts only after the referee's first invoice is marked paid

coupon_engine_rules.stacking: At most one price-modifying coupon per subscription. Credit-ledger grants (REFER1M, guarantee credits, cooling-off refunds) are not price-modifying and always coexist.
coupon_engine_rules.interval_discount_interaction: Interval discounts (quarterly/annual) are part of the list price, not a coupon. percent_off applies AFTER the interval discount, to the interval price_mnt.
coupon_engine_rules.floor: Resulting net price per month-equivalent must be >= billing_rules.min_net_after_discount_per_month_mnt (49000). A coupon that would breach the floor is rejected with COUPON_BELOW_FLOOR.
coupon_engine_rules.addons_default: Coupons never apply to add-ons unless applies_to_addons is true. Scarce-inventory placement SKUs are marked discountable:false and are never discountable by any coupon, including admin-issued ones.
coupon_engine_rules.rounding: Discounted price = floor(base_price_mnt * (10000 - percent_off_bp) / 10000). Rounds down, in the partner's favour.

phases.offer: 12 months of Growth at 0 MNT, then the FOUNDING override price (174,500 MNT/mo net, 50% of list) for a further 24 months. Permanent founding_partner badge.
obligations: median_first_response_hours <= 48 measured over any rolling 30-day window
phases.revocation: If median_first_response_hours > 72 over a rolling 30-day window, the founding_partner badge is suspended and search.rank_boost drops to the free-tier value until remedied. Two consecutive suspensions terminate the FOUNDING price override at the next term boundary and convert to LAUNCH50.

phases.offer: LAUNCH50 (50% off) for the first term, up to 12 discounted months. 60-day free trial before the first invoice is issued.
phases.trial_mechanic: No payment instrument exists in v1 (manual invoicing), so a trial is simply subscription.status='trialing' with invoice generation suppressed until trial_ends_at. No card, no auto-charge, no dark pattern. At trial end the partner must actively confirm; silence downgrades to free, it does not create a debt.

graduation_criteria.description: Launch pricing closes to NEW signups only when every criterion below holds for 2 consecutive calendar months. Evaluated by a monthly cron and recorded in launch_phase_evaluation. Deliberately gated on learner-side supply, so the platform cannot raise prices while it is still under-delivering.

criteria.note: share of paying partners who triggered a guarantee credit that month

graduation_criteria.grandfathering: Existing partners keep their locked rate until the current term ends, then step up one rung per renewal: launch rate -> 75% of list for one full term -> list. No partner ever sees more than a 33% increase at a single renewal, and every increase is notified 45 days before the renewal invoice.

guarantee.evaluation: monthly, on the 3rd day of the following month, by cron
guarantee.formula: shortfall_bp = max(0, floor((G - D) * 10000 / G)) where G = guaranteed qualified inquiries for the plan, D = delivered qualified inquiries. credit_mnt = floor(month_equivalent_net_mnt * shortfall_bp / 10000). If D < G/2, credit_mnt = month_equivalent_net_mnt (100%).
guarantee.credit_destination: partner_credit_ledger, applied automatically to the next invoice

caps.on_cap_reached: Stop issuing credits, open an admin task 'guarantee_cap_reached'. A partner in a genuinely dead category gets a conversation and a plan downgrade or exit, not an indefinitely free subscription.

void_conditions: profile_completeness_pct < 80 at any point during the evaluated month
subscription.status != 'active' for the whole evaluated month
partner was in a free trial for the whole evaluated month

all_of: learner account age >= 24 hours at submission
learner has a verified phone (OTP) OR verified email
message_length >= 20 chars OR structured intent form fully completed

learner granted explicit, unbundled consent to share contact details with this specific partner (Mongolia Law on Personal Data Protection, in force 2022-05-01, requires written or electronic consent naming the recipient and the fields transferred)
not a duplicate: no prior inquiry from the same learner to the same partner within 30 days
not marked spam or fraudulent by an admin within 7 days of submission
learner is not a linked staff member of the partner and shares no verified phone number with one
the partner's inquiry_unlock entitlement was available at submission time (a partner who exhausted their quota still receives the inquiry, and it still counts toward the guarantee)
qualified_inquiry_definition.adjudication: Partners may dispute an inquiry's qualified status within 14 days via POST /api/v1/partner/:id/inquiries/:inquiryId/dispute. Admin ruling is final. A disputed-and-upheld inquiry is removed from D and the guarantee is re-evaluated.

guarantee.month_equivalent_net_mnt: floor(term_net_mnt / months_in_term). For chain:annual this is 1,241,666 MNT, not the quarterly-derived figure. Always derive from the term the partner actually bought.
guarantee.calibration_rule: Every tier's guarantee must sit at 1.5x-2.0x its monthly contribution break-even (monthly_net / value_per_qualified_inquiry_contribution_mnt). Below 1.5x the guarantee is not credible to a buyer; above 2.0x it is a giveaway the platform cannot deliver. A chain guarantee of 20 per location x 5 locations = 100 was rejected at design time: it scored 4.2x and would have consumed 25% of all platform inquiries at the graduation gate. The guarantee is a flat 40 for chain, NOT per-location.
guarantee.solvency_rule: sum(guarantees of all active paying partners) must never exceed 70% of trailing-3-month platform qualified inquiry volume. A monthly cron computes guarantee_coverage_ratio; above 0.70 the system blocks new paid signups above Basic and raises an admin alert. Selling more guarantee than the platform can deliver is the fastest route to insolvency in a marketplace business.

proration.rounding: customer_favourable: credits use ceil(), charges use floor(). Maximum drift 2 MNT per change, always in the partner's favour.

upgrade.trigger: target_plan.tier_rank > current_plan.tier_rank, or same rank with a higher net price
upgrade.effective: immediately on request, BEFORE payment. Entitlements unlock at once; the invoice follows. Withholding value from a partner who just agreed to pay more is a conversion killer, and the downside is bounded by the existing suspension ladder.
upgrade.invoicing: If delta >= min_invoice_amount_mnt (20000): issue a proration invoice, due in 7 days. If 0 < delta < 20000: do NOT issue an invoice; append the amount as a line item on the next scheduled invoice. Issuing a 4,000 MNT bank-transfer invoice costs more in reconciliation time than it collects.
upgrade.quotas: New limits apply immediately. Consumed counters carry over unchanged; already-unlocked inquiries stay unlocked permanently.
upgrade.period_end: unchanged - an upgrade never extends or resets the term

downgrade.trigger: target_plan.tier_rank < current_plan.tier_rank, or same rank with a lower net price
downgrade.effective: at current_period_end only. Stored as subscription.pending_plan_code / pending_effective_at.
downgrade.refund: none. Mid-term refunds are not offered; MNT bank refunds plus ebarimt credit notes are operationally expensive and invite abuse. Any genuine overpayment goes to partner_credit_ledger instead.
downgrade.cancellable: The pending downgrade can be cancelled any time before pending_effective_at.

enforcement_at_effective_date.principle: Never delete partner data on downgrade. Gate access only, so re-upgrade restores everything instantly. This is both correct UX and the strongest re-upgrade lever.
enforcement_at_effective_date.course_listings: Keep the top N by (qualified_inquiries_90d DESC, updated_at DESC); the remainder move to status 'hidden_by_quota'.
enforcement_at_effective_date.staff_seats: Keep the owner plus the highest-role members; suspend the remainder ordered by last_login_at ASC.
enforcement_at_effective_date.locations: Keep the primary plus the top by qualified_inquiries_90d DESC; the remainder move to 'hidden_by_quota'.
enforcement_at_effective_date.photos_videos: Keep the first N by sort_order ASC; the remainder move to 'hidden_by_quota'.
enforcement_at_effective_date.analytics_history: Access window narrows to the new tier's retention_days. Underlying rows are retained per the data-retention policy, not the entitlement.
enforcement_at_effective_date.active_addons: Add-ons whose min_plan exceeds the new tier are cancelled at the same effective date and their inventory slots released. The partner is notified 14 days beforehand.

interval_change.monthly_to_annual: Treated as an upgrade. Unused monthly days are credited against the annual invoice using the same formula; a new 12-month term starts on the effective date.
interval_change.annual_to_monthly: Takes effect at current_period_end only. Never mid-term.
interval_change.quarterly_to_annual: Treated as an upgrade, same as monthly_to_annual.

cancellation.cooling_off: Full refund if requested within 14 days of the partner's FIRST paid invoice on their FIRST paid term.
cancellation.on_effect: subscription.status -> 'canceled', partner plan -> 'free', all free-tier enforcement rules above apply, listing remains in the directory.

hard_rules: rank_boost is a multiplier on relevance, never an override. An irrelevant Premium centre never outranks a relevant Basic centre for a specific query.
search.paid_floor=false (free tier) sorts strictly below all paid listings within the same relevance band, but a highly relevant free listing still outranks an irrelevant paid one across bands.
Featured and sponsored placements are visually labelled 'Сурталчилгаа' / 'Ивээн тэтгэсэн'. Paid position is never disguised as organic.
Responsiveness can cost a paying partner more rank than money can buy them. This is deliberate: the fastest way to kill this marketplace is to let paying partners degrade the learner experience.

seed_sources: public website or Facebook page URL
hard_rules: Seeded entries contain ONLY factual, publicly published information. Never generate descriptions, ratings, reviews, testimonials, student counts, or pricing for a business that did not supply them.
Every seeded entry renders a persistent 'Баталгаажаагүй' (Unverified) label and a 'Энэ бол миний төв' (This is my centre) claim link.
Every seeded entry carries a one-click removal request that is honoured within 5 business days, no questions asked, no retention attempt.
A seeded entry never receives a promoted placement and is never presented as a platform recommendation.

claim_flow.on_claim: Entry moves to claimed_unverified on the free plan. Any inquiries that accrued while unclaimed become visible in masked form immediately, which is the single strongest upgrade trigger in the funnel.

deliberate_limitations.primary_lever: Inquiries arrive and are visible in count and masked preview, but cannot be answered.

masking_spec.learner_name: first grapheme plus a middle dot, e.g. 'Б·'
masking_spec.rationale: Show enough intent for the partner to feel the money walking past; reveal nothing that lets them contact the learner off-platform.

other_limits: 0 course listings - the free entry is a name card, not a shopfront
no price display, no JLPT level filters, so the listing is invisible to the highest-intent search facets
ranks strictly below every paid listing in the same relevance band
30-day profile-view count only, no inquiry analytics

learner_protection.rule: A free listing must never become a dead end for a learner.
learner_protection.mechanic: If an inquiry to a free (or any) listing is unanswered after 14 days, notify the learner and surface 3 responsive alternatives matched on level, goal and district. If a free listing accumulates 5 unanswered inquiries, suppress it from search until it responds or claims.
learner_protection.note: This also converts: the partner sees 'Танд хариулаагүй 5 хүсэлт байна' and their listing going dark.

upgrade_paths: In-dashboard inquiry list with a per-row 'Холбоо барих мэдээллийг нээх' CTA priced at the current plan or a lead pack
Email digest to the claimed contact: 'Энэ сард 7 суралцагч тантай холбогдохыг хүссэн' with a plan comparison
Sales outreach triggered when masked_inquiries_30d >= 8 on a free listing

unit_economics_assumptions.note: Every price in this catalog is derived from these figures. Re-derive the ladder if they move materially.

facebook_benchmark.note: Platform pricing must beat 33,000 MNT per qualified inquiry to be strictly cheaper than Facebook. At guaranteed floor delivery every tier lands at 30,000-37,000 MNT (roughly FB parity, so the guarantee is a real floor and not a giveaway); at expected delivery every tier lands at 16,000-19,000 MNT, roughly 2x better than Facebook.

unit_economics_assumptions.ladder_invariant: Every tier is priced at 2.0-2.5% of its target segment's annual revenue. Basic 1.49M against a 60M centre = 2.5%. Growth 3.49M against 150M = 2.3%. Premium 7.49M against 350M = 2.1%. If a tier drifts outside 2.0-2.6%, it is mispriced.
